articles.title: Mamdani vs. Griffin Standoff Puts $6 Million Tower at Risk
articles.summary: Citadel’s Ken Griffin said he’s meeting with New York Governor Kathy Hochul on Thursday to talk about the future direction of America’s biggest city after a spat with Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s over Griffin's $238 million Manhattan penthouse (Source: Bloomberg)
